verdict.rationale: Conductor documents its own API and a hosted MCP server, but their stated scope is managing cloud workspaces: creating workspaces, sending prompts and reading replies. Nothing shows parity with the many UI features, such as local worktree workspaces, model loadouts, sidebar sections, port forwarding, Reassign/Follow, or diff review, PR and merge flows. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every path. missing for 10: API coverage of local workspaces and UI-only features (reassign/follow, sections, settings, review/PR/merge, checkpoints), a published machine-readable API spec, any statement of UI-API parity, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Conductor API lets you manage cloud workspaces programmatically. Use it to do things like: Create workspaces, send prompts to the coding agent, and read its replies.
Conductor's hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, and other MCP clients manage your cloud workspaces.
